verdict.rationale: uv is a Python package and project manager, not an agent or assistant that consumes tools. Acting as an MCP client is a category error for this kind of product, and nothing in the evidence shows uv connecting to MCP servers. Its `uv tool run`/`uvx` feature runs Python CLI tools in ephemeral environments, which is not consuming MCP tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
